drg.description: Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without MV >96 Hours without MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 63-year-old male admitted for urinary tract infection. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.53, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 14.1, platelets 224, sodium 140, wbc 8.8; vitals dbp 70-74, heart_rate 69-75, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 129-135, spo2 97-99, temp 37-37.5
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Sepsis.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.98, hemoglobin 14.1, platelets 223, sodium 140, wbc 8.9; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 69-74, map 90-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 131-135, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Sepsis. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 63-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Urinary tract infection. Sepsis. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
